mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_user_memory (user_id, memory_type, memory_key, content, importance, source_conversation_id, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{memoryType}, #{memoryKey}, #{content}, #{importance}, #{sourceConversationId}, #{expiresAt}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, memory_type, memory_key) DO UPDATE SET content = EXCLUDED.content, importance = GREATEST(ai_user_memory.importance, EXCLUDED.importance), source_conversation_id = EXCLUDED.source_conversation_id, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at, updated_at = now()
